description: This file defines cache provider interfaces and implementations for Mattermost, including in-memory LRU and Redis-based cache providers, with methods for creating, connecting, and managing caches.

classes.name: Provider
classes.description: Interface for cache providers, including methods for creating caches, connecting, setting metrics, closing, and getting cache type.

classes.name: RedisOptions
classes.description: Configuration options specific to Redis provider.

methods.name: NewProvider
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory cache provider.

methods.name: NewRedisProvider
methods.description: Creates a new Redis cache provider with specified options.

methods.name: NewCache
methods.description: Creates a new cache instance based on options.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the cache backend.

methods.name: SetMetrics
methods.description: Sets metrics interface for the provider.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Releases resources used by the provider.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type of cache (LRU or Redis).
